_why: Measured durations of the rendered VO lines. Checked in so the no-overlap invariant is tested against what the film actually plays, not a words-per-second guess (the guess was 25% slow: 4.55s estimated vs 3.62s real). Regenerate after changing any VO_LINES text: pnpm promo:audio, then rebuild this from promo/out/.vo-cache/*.json.
